description.sl: 11. novembra. Otroci gredo z lučkami skozi vas in pojejo, v gostilni je martinova gos, povsod pa diši po pečenem kostanju.
description.en: 11 November. The children walk through the village with lanterns and sing, there's St Martin's goose at the inn, and everywhere smells of roast chestnuts.
description.it: 11 novembre. I bambini attraversano il paese con le lanterne e cantano, all'osteria c'è l'oca di San Martino e dappertutto c'è profumo di caldarroste.

words.example_it: La mia lanterna fa una luce gialla.

words.example_de: Die Gans läuft über die Wiese.
words.example_en: The goose runs across the meadow.
words.note: Das Martinigansl: Austrian for the roast goose of St Martin's Day.
words.note_sl: Das Martinigansl: avstrijsko za martinovo gos.
words.note_it: Das Martinigansl: in Austria, l'oca arrosto di San Martino.
Parola austriaca; in Germania: die Maronen.

words.example_de: Martin teilt seinen Mantel mit einem armen Mann.
words.example_sl: Martin deli svoj plašč z revnim možem.
words.example_en: Martin shares his cloak with a poor man.
words.example_it: Martino divide il suo mantello con un povero.

words.example_de: Im November wird es früh dunkel.
words.example_en: In November it gets dark early.
The children sing a lantern song.
words.example_it: I bambini cantano una canzone delle lanterne.

words.example_en: St Martin's Day is in November.
